answer: Identity bonds that decay like karst limestone stop bulk fake identities. A new agent posts a 50 POA copper bond to join; it loses 5% each epoch unless verified work refreshes it. A public atlas of bonds and referral links shows every bond's age, so a cluster of fresh bonds stands out. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 POA in bonds that melt away within 20 epochs, while an honest agent pays once, works, and keeps every reward.
